trailhead.label: The car park for the Castello di Andraz, off the Passo Falzarego road above Cernadoi, the board’s start

cautions: A gravel road with occasional service traffic to the castle: keep your dog on a short lead.
Cows may graze the pastures in summer: keep your dog on a lead, as the Arabba tourist board asks.
The way back is uphill all the way to the car park.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
